# executes procedure

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:executesProcedure`](gmeow-executesProcedure.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/executesProcedure>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/procedures`](../../slices/procedures.md)

Relates an [`Execution`](../classes/gmeow-Execution.md) to the [`Procedure`](../classes/gmeow-Procedure.md) it enacts. Non-functional: an execution may enact multiple procedures (a combined run), and competing enactment claims coexist.
